purpose: Measure the repository scanner's actual GLRT-64 application call and locate dominant exact-compute stages.

selection.rule: first physical case at each of 2.5 and 5 Msps ordered by session_id, source_start_counter, visit_index, case_id

application_call.ci16_conversion: recorded separately before the detector call

passes_per_case: one uninstrumented actual application call for process CPU and wall time
one separately instrumented diagnostic call for nested stage counts/timing and exact-output comparison
measurement.reason_no_warmup: keep the two-rate real application profile bounded; each rate records first-use cache state

exactness: The diagnostic pass must exactly equal the uninstrumented DwellDetection serialized output. Future candidates must match the same serialized application output before timing claims.
interpretation: Nested stage times are inclusive and must not be summed as exclusive time.
This profiles the repository scanner analysis workload on saved IQ; it does not establish that live deployed DS5 currently runs this path.
No holdout, RF, production edit, ARM claim, or threshold tuning is allowed.
